rates.quote: d) 15 Prozent des Bruttobetrags der Dividenden in allen anderen Fällen.
if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Art. 27a Anspruch auf Vorteile: Ungeachtet der übrigen Bestimmungen dieses Abkommens wird ein Vorteil nach diesem Abkommen nicht für bestimmte Einkünfte oder Vermögenswerte gewährt, wenn unter Berücksichtigung aller massgeblichen Tatsachen und Umstände die Feststellung gerechtfertigt ist, dass der Erhalt dieses Vorteils einer der Hauptzwecke einer Gestaltung oder Transaktion war, die unmittelbar oder mittelbar zu diesem Vorteil geführt hat

notes: Dividend 0% (>=50%, 365 days) and 5% (>=10%, 365 days) tiers also require capital invested > CHF 2,000,000 / > CHF 100,000 respectively at payment date. Art. 10(2)(b) (Protocol): 0% where beneficial owner is a pension scheme or the central bank of the other State (not modelled). Pre-protocol (2008-01-01 to 2023-12-31): 5% if company holds directly >=25% and invested capital > CHF 200,000, otherwise 15%. Art. 11(3): interest taxable only in residence State if paid in connection with sale on credit of industrial/commercial/scientific equipment or on any loan granted by a bank; Protocol adds c) paid to the Government, political subdivisions, local authorities or central bank. Protocol in force 2 May 2023 ('In Kraft getreten durch Notenaustausch am 2. Mai 2023'); art. 23(2)(a): applies to source taxes on income paid or credited on or after 1 January of the calendar year following entry into force -> 2024-01-01. Original Agreement art. 28: WHT on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2007-11-07 -> 2008-01-01). Not MLI-covered; PPT via treaty art. 27a.
